name: Thebes
locality: Commune of Thiva, Viotia, Thiva Municipality
text: Thebes ( THEEBZ; Greek: Θήβα, Thíva [ˈθiva]; Ancient Greek: Θῆβαι, Thêbai [tʰɛ̂ːbai̯]) is a city in Boeotia, Central Greece, and one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world. It is the largest city in Boeotia and a major center for the region. Ancient Thebes was the largest and leading polis of the Boeotian League.

depictions.name: Thebes
depictions.text: Thebes, Egypt Thebes, a city in Greece Thebes, known to ancient Egyptians as Waset, was a city on the eastern bank of the Nile and the capital of Egypt during the Middle and New Kingdom periods. It resided across the river from the Valley of the Kings and was home to a cult of Amun which operated out of Karnak. Thebes was also the birthplace of two Order of the Ancients members, Khaliset and Medunamun.
